name: Violencia del Narcotrafico
description: Mas de 30,000 homicidios anuales vinculados al crimen organizado. Carteles controlan territorios completos del pais.
description_en: Over 30,000 annual homicides linked to organized crime. Cartels control entire territories of the country.

name: Corrupcion Sistemica
description: Corrupcion enraizada en todos los niveles de gobierno. Impunidad superior al 95% en delitos cometidos.
description_en: Corruption rooted at all levels of government. Impunity exceeds 95% for committed crimes.

name: Desigualdad Extrema
description: El 1% mas rico posee mas que el 50% inferior. Brecha enorme entre norte industrializado y sur rural.
description_en: The richest 1% owns more than the bottom 50%. Huge gap between industrialized north and rural south.

name: Feminicidios
description: Mas de 10 mujeres asesinadas diariamente. Cultura de impunidad y falta de perspectiva de genero en la justicia.
description_en: Over 10 women murdered daily. Culture of impunity and lack of gender perspective in the justice system.

name: Economia Informal
description: Mas del 55% de los trabajadores en la informalidad sin seguridad social ni prestaciones laborales.
description_en: Over 55% of workers in the informal sector without social security or labor benefits.

name: Calidad Educativa
description: Resultados deficientes en evaluaciones internacionales. Desercion escolar alta en secundaria y preparatoria.
description_en: Poor performance in international assessments. High dropout rates in secondary and high school.

name: Crisis del Agua
description: Ciudad de Mexico enfrenta Dia Cero. Acuiferos sobreexplotados y distribucion desigual del recurso hidrico.
description_en: Mexico City faces Day Zero. Overexploited aquifers and unequal distribution of water resources.

name: Migracion Forzada
description: Mexico como pais de origen, transito y destino migratorio. Presion estadounidense y crisis humanitaria en la frontera sur.
description_en: Mexico as a country of origin, transit, and destination for migration. US pressure and humanitarian crisis on the southern border.
